# Provenance: captured 2026-09-06 on Darwin via `codex --help` (codex-cli 0.153.4)
# plus the live `~/.codex/config.toml` entry `model_reasoning_effort = "medium"`.
# Purpose: pins the effort-config grammar EffortCapability depends on (issue #3541, L2 fixture).
# Codex has no `--effort` flag (`codex --help` / `codex exec --help` contain no
# "effort" line); reasoning effort is a config key overridden with `-c key="value"`.
# Minimal excerpt: only the -c/--config mechanism lines are retained.
#
  -c, --config <key=value>
          Override a configuration value that would otherwise be loaded from `~/.codex/config.toml`.
          Use a dotted path (`foo.bar.baz`) to override nested values. The `value` portion is parsed
          as TOML. If it fails to parse as TOML, the raw string is used as a literal.

          Examples: - `-c model="o3"` - `-c 'sandbox_permissions=["disk-full-read-access"]'` - `-c
          shell_environment_policy.inherit=all`
# Live config evidence (same machine, same date):
#   ~/.codex/config.toml contains: model_reasoning_effort = "medium"
# Hence the injected form: -c model_reasoning_effort="<low|medium|high>"
